questions.question_text: How is data commonly used in sports to improve performance?

options.text: To design team uniforms for better style
To track player stats like speed and scoring for strategy
To decide ticket prices for games
To choose the music played at stadiumsCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: In the case study of “BrightFuture High,” how did the school use data to improve student performance in science?

options.text: By canceling science classes to reduce stress
By analyzing test scores and surveys to introduce fun lab workshops
By increasing homework without checking student feedback
By ignoring attendance records and focusing only on gradesCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of data being used for disaster response, as mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: Tracking student grades to assign extra credit
Using satellite data to predict hurricane paths and guide rescuers
Counting likes on social media posts for a campaign
Measuring sales data for a local storeCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: What did the Indian high school group “Team Swachh” achieve using data, according to the chapter?

options.text: They created a new video game about cleaning
They collected data on trash locations to push for cleanups, clearing over 50 dump sites
They used data to improve school cafeteria food
They tracked weather data for school eventsCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: In the group project from Section 3, what is a key step after identifying a local problem like litter in a park?

options.text: Immediately buying more trash cans without research
Collecting data through observations or surveys to understand the issue
Ignoring the problem and choosing a different topic
Writing a story about the park without evidenceCorrect Answer:B
